tasks.title: Separate hydration and probes from pure planning
tasks.goal: Make adapter inspection operate only on admitted prepared captures.
steps: Trace each prepare/plan/projection call to hydration, cache writes, PATH resolution and version probes.
Introduce an explicit prepared-input/evidence carrier using M-01 and M-16 contracts; move hydration/probes into named effectful preparation.
Make plan/inspect consume that carrier and return needs-preparation for absent/stale capture; preserve offline propagation.
positive_cases: Prepared source supports deterministic plan/inspect with zero write/network/process calls.
Explicit preparation records exact source/client/probe identity.
negative_cases: Empty cache cannot cause hidden hydration or native execution during query.
Changed source/client evidence refuses rather than silently reprobes.

tasks.safe_stop: Pure query path works and effectful preparation is explicit; no apply required.
tasks.commit_subject: refactor(adapters): separate preparation from pure projection planning
notes: Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

Chosen prototype: host-owned in-memory AdapterPlanRoute; explicit startup --prepare on bounded JSON-lines vibe adapter-plan command; configured MCP Arc shares exact route/capture/context/target. No wire prepare verb, persisted capability database, new resolver/context registry or raw world getter. Missing/stale captures return generated typed NeedsPreparation; configured positive route must work.

Effectful preparation alone owns hydration/composition/PATH/version/list and offline forwarding. Pure plan, public inspect, fingerprint and legacy dry-run cannot call them or native Plan. Install/apply may explicitly prepare within their effectful operation. Captures are provenance, never fresh write authority.

New command registration includes command_progress policy/inventory: AdapterPlan is PersistentProtocol without generic activity. Additive PROP054/080 updates preserve all prior clauses and accepted A2 contracts. Existing lifecycle test allowing plan-time version/list must explicitly separate preparation from the zero-effect query interval.

Raw selected skill closure uses existing M01 selection/extraction plus finite owner-private SafeFS captures; document-only SourceQueryService APIs must not be misrepresented as arbitrary skill capture. Any genuinely missing existing-owner API requires an exact packet correction before writes.

Exact offline preparation policy must be forwarded from incumbent RunMetadata.offline in install/mod.rs::regenerate_native_world and install/ready.rs::apply to world::prepare_owner_runtime_inputs; update only their actual helper-signature test callers in phase/prerequisite/tests.rs and dispatch/native_all_owner_tests/support.rs as needed. These four exact owners are authorized after the first managed B1 handback exposed the missing perimeter. Preserve all other lifecycle/install rules; no ambient/global policy fallback or independent resolver.

Complete upper integration includes effectful callback.rs::stage and phase/invocation.rs::prepare plus phase.rs execution planning and world/invocation.rs carrier construction. Consume an exact retained prepared capture/sidecar through incumbent owners; do not restore hydration in query or break PROP-054 ADMITTED-INVOCATION-ORDER by running effects before full admission. Existing callback run.native preparation and phase prerequisite ordering must be traced. Extend the already bound meaningful world/adapter tests for these actual consumers, with no unsupported full-command claim. The first partial B1 delta remains unaccepted until the complete original B1 safe stop and all criteria are met.

tasks.title: Resolve bridge sources against their captured root
tasks.goal: Fix any demonstrated hydrated source-root mismatch without inventing an unobserved bug.
steps: Create a fixture where provider.root differs from the hydrated captured source root and resources include nested files.
Trace actual resource resolution through automatic binding; record whether the suspected mismatch reproduces.
If reproduced, carry the admitted source root through resource selection and include closure/digest checks; if not, retain the characterization proving the correct current path.
positive_cases: Captured nested resources project from the exact hydrated capture.
negative_cases: Provider-relative fallback cannot read a different resource with the same name.
Missing/changed captured resource gives an explicit refusal rather than a partial plugin.
